title: Tuskegee Airmen
hook: The data this week comes from the Tuskegee Airmen Challenge as part of the Veterans Advocacy Tableau User Group with data sourced from the CAF (Commemorative Air Force) CAF. This dataset is released in honor of Black History Month and honors the sacrifices and challenges that these African American pilots faced in WWII and beyond. Credit to Ethan Lang and Timothy Blaisdell of the VA-TUG for preparing the challenge and Allen Hillery for collaborating on connecting us all and getting the challenge kicked off. Credit to Anthony Starks, Sekou Tyler, and Allen Hillery for kicking off the WEB DuBois challenge in past years and this year's challenge for 2022.
